name: phone_capabilities
description: First call: inspect permissions, accessibility, lock/power state, phone accounts, operation_prefix and nonce length bounds. Direct Android APIs are preferred.

name: phone_observe
description: Observe screen nodes and optional screenshot. display_target defaults to the private virtual display; use physical only to inspect the visible device screen at the user's request. Coordinates use full target-display dimensions; resized images need scaling. Screenshot is omitted by default. Get a fresh snapshot before every action.

max_nodes.description: Maximum accessibility nodes to request. The default is 40 and observations are additionally byte-bounded; nodes_truncated reports either limit.

display_target.description: Target the private agent virtual display by default. Use physical only when the user explicitly wants Pocket Agent to inspect, control, or present content on the visible device screen.

name: phone_act
description: Perform an Android screen action using a recent snapshot_id. display_target must match the target used to obtain snapshot_id. Prefer exact semantic selectors. For rich note editors such as Google Keep, accessibility text replacement may appear without saving: click the intended field, observe, then type with input_method=keyboard and verify by reopening. Keyboard input supports up to 2000 representable characters on private displays; unsupported characters fail before typing, so use an acceptable transliteration when appropriate. replace defaults to true. Other typing uses accessibility. Enter uses real IME action. Input acceptance is not task completion. display_target defaults to private virtual; use physical only with explicit visible-screen authorization. operation_id must be phone_capabilities.operation_prefix + underscore + a unique 8..48 character nonce; reuse identical IDs and arguments after uncertain results.

operation_id.description: Current phone_capabilities.operation_prefix + '_' + a unique 8..48 character nonce using only ASCII letters, digits, '_' or '-'. Include owner/generation/action/attempt or a timestamp for uniqueness. A valid suffix example is _type_0001; never reuse the example across actions. Preserve identical IDs/arguments after uncertain results.

name: phone_open_url
description: Open a validated HTTP(S) URL. Only on virtual displays, Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=PACKAGE links use the private Store session automatically: an idle background Store task transfers into the agent display and closes on phone_screen release. A visible Store or another worker's task cannot be taken over. Observe the app listing, tap Install, and verify installation with phone_apps. Other URLs and all physical-display URLs use Android ACTION_VIEW. display_target defaults to virtual; physical requires the user's explicit request. Verify the resulting screen after launch.

name: phone_screen
description: Release this conversation's virtual display when its UI work is finished. Displays are acquired automatically on the first screen interaction; SMS, calling and other direct Android APIs never allocate one. Up to three displays run concurrently; further UI work waits until a display is freed.

name: phone_batch
description: Validate up to 8 direct tool calls before execution. Ordered screen mutations. Every mutation has its own operation_id. Stops on the first error. Not atomic. Retry with SAME IDs after a lost response; never replay unknown outcomes.

name: phone_shell
description: General unrestricted Android shell on this phone through Shizuku; no PC/USB connection required. Available to main and every worker. Actions: context returns persistent workspace paths and assigned display; acquire/release manage a private display; exec starts arbitrary /system/bin/sh code asynchronously; poll reads combined output by byte offset and exit status; stop signals a session shell; capture returns a private-display image independently of accessibility; image returns an image at any shell-readable path. Commands may create/reuse scripts, files and other processes. There is no command allowlist or display filtering. Android shell UID permissions still apply. exec does not wait for completion: save session_id and poll; never repeat an uncertain command. Files in scripts_directory persist for future tasks. Each exec starts a new shell; use cwd and files for state. Environment includes POCKET_SHELL_HOME, POCKET_SCRIPTS_DIR, POCKET_WORK_DIR and POCKET_DISPLAY_ID/WIDTH/HEIGHT (empty without an assigned display). Use display-specific input commands for your allocated task. capture does not use phone_act snapshots or their expiry. Image coordinates use coordinate_width/height, not the resized image dimensions.
